summary: Iteration 111 — Future Skills Centre Economics + Reports KPI extras + Expenses perf fix. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (CRUD, mirror to school_expenses, category mapping rent/teacher_cost/capex/marketing/other → rent/teacher_cost/kit_cost/marketing_cost/other, PATCH reflects in mirror, DELETE removes from both listings, 3-segment delete path does NOT collide with catch-all, permission gating for future_skills.economics granular perm, denial for user with no perms, reports.revenue.aov/cost/profit/profit_margin_pct present). Frontend: /admin/future-skills → Centre Economics tab renders with Revenue/Cost/Profit/Margin summary + all 5 category tiles + empty state; Add Expense modal opens, POST returns 200 (mirrored) — modal centre pre-filled from top filter; category='other' surfaces the free-text label input; Reports tab shows AOV (₹14,500) + Profit Margin (100%) KPI cards below top summary; Add Role modal contains all 7 new FS sub-permissions (Centre Economics + 6 KPIs); /admin/expenses page loaded in 3.27s with 0 base64 image srcs leaking to DOM (payload dropped to 11.5 KB, 127 ms API). No regressions observed on other FS tabs.

integration_issues.issue: Entries created with an expense_date OUTSIDE the currently-selected month filter succeed on the server (POST 200 + mirrored) but silently disappear from the table because the panel immediately re-fetches with the current month filter (e.g., 2026-07). Users may think 'nothing happened'. Suggest: after a successful add, if the entry's expense_date month != current filter month, either (a) auto-set the filter to that month, or (b) surface a toast '✅ Added — switch to <month> to view it'.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: When Add Expense succeeds with a date not in the current month filter, auto-jump the filter to that month (or show a persistent toast with the month link) so users don't perceive the add as silently failing.

OPTIONAL UX: The month filter defaults to the current calendar month (server-side today = 2026-07). Consider defaulting to 'All Time' on first load of Centre Economics so admins see historical entries without needing to clear the filter.
critical_code_review_comments: expenses.py get_all_school_expenses: data-URI stripping is correct and idempotent (creates indexes once). Perf improvement verified (11.5 KB / 127 ms for 16 rows).

future_skills.py centre-economics DELETE path deliberately uses `/entry/{id}` to avoid catch-all collision — verified in test_delete_endpoint_path_does_not_collide_with_catchall (returns 404 not 200-no-op).

PATCH mirror behaviour: since the FS entry IS the school_expenses row (single-doc model), any patch to amount/category/description automatically updates the mirror. Category mapping on PATCH is also re-applied. Well-designed — no dual-write drift possible.

Permission model is sensible: `future_skills.economics` grants only economics endpoints; broader FS admin endpoints still require `_is_admin` (super_admin, admin, fs_center_owner, or holder of the wider `future_skills` perm). Verified via a temp team_user in tests.

AdminFutureSkills.jsx CentreEconomicsPanel uses its own local centerId state (`useState('all')`) which does NOT sync with the parent panel's centerId. Not a bug (economics tab has its own filter UI) — flagging for awareness only.
